title: SoundCloud likes paging accepts encoded user URNs and binds the cursor to the caller
acceptance: A server-returned SoundCloud next_href on a percent-encoded URN path (/users/soundcloud%3Ausers%3A<id>/likes/tracks?…) continues paging instead of ending the list at about 200 songs.
A client-supplied likes cursor that names a different SoundCloud user than the connected account is rejected with the existing 422, so a hand-made cursor cannot page another user's likes.
Tests cover both, and the existing off-path next_href and client-cursor tests still pass.
Owner or agent check with a SoundCloud account of more than 200 likes shows Load more past 200.
nextAction: From the #665 (RF-132) reviews: round 4 item 3 (an encoded URN next_href ends the list with no error) and round 3 item 10 (a hand-made cursor can read another user's public likes with the caller's own token; low impact, those likes are public). The owner's SoundCloud account has 2 likes (2026-10-30), so the 200+ check needs another account. Files: packages/music/src/soundcloud.ts and apps/api/src/lib/music/likes-cursor.ts. Owner-gated (provider code). Agent-created: Backlog until the owner sets Ready.

evidence.summary: Final review of #665 on 42da99c, logged item 3: a percent-encoded SoundCloud URN next_href ends the list at about 200 songs, no worse than production before RF-132.
Final review of #665 on 0a66217, logged item 10: a hand-made cursor can fetch another user's public SoundCloud likes with the caller's own token.

Owner Mac Chrome check on production d888d28, 2026-10-30: after reconnecting SoundCloud, Music › Songs showed the account's 2 liked songs and no Load more, which is correct for that account; paging past 200 is untested.
